title: React v2 Findings Theater: two-column list + slide-in drawer with evidence, AI enrichment, CVSS, OWASP, and attack path tab
goal: Build src/components/screens/FindingsTheater.tsx. REQUIRES backlog-268. Layout: two columns — LEFT (findings list, 55%) and RIGHT (finding detail drawer, 45%, hidden when no finding selected). FINDINGS LIST: Filter bar at top with: severity filter (All/Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info), status filter (all/open/false-positive/fixed), search text input. Call GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/findings?theater=true from the API. Group findings by severity. Each finding row shows: colored severity badge (Critical=red, High=amber, Medium=yellow, Low=cyan, Info=grey), finding title, tool that found it (small tag), target (truncated to 30 chars), status badge. Clicking a row: set selectedFindingId in store, load detail. FINDING DETAIL DRAWER — slides in from right using Framer Motion. Header: finding title + severity badge. Sections (collapsible): (a) SUMMARY: description text. CVSS score gauge (0-10 scale, color-coded). OWASP category badge (e.g. 'A01:2021 Broken Access Control'). (b) TECHNICAL EVIDENCE: the finding's raw_evidence text in a monospace code block with copy button. SHA-256 hash shown below. (c) AI ENRICHMENT: business_impact and remediation_steps from ai_enrichment data (if available). If not available and ChatGPT connected: 'Enrich Now' button that POSTs to /api/v1/runs/{runId}/findings/{findingId}/enrich. If not connected: 'Connect ChatGPT in Settings to enable'. (d) REMEDIATION: step-by-step fix list. 'Mark as Fixed' button (PATCH /api/v1/findings/{id} with status=fixed). 'Mark as False Positive' button. (e) PUSH TO JIRA: button visible if Jira configured in settings. POSTs to integration endpoint. (f) ATTACK PATH TAB: only visible when finding has compound_chain_id. Shows the chain as a horizontal flow: [Finding A] → [caused] → [Finding B] → [enabled] → [Finding C]. Each node shows title, severity, tool. Arrows show the causal reasoning text from AgentReasoning. Close button (X) on drawer hides it.
scope: React v2 Findings Theater replaces the old findings.js. Two-column layout with slide-in drawer.
generation_reason: Findings Theater is the primary analysis screen. Must show real findings with evidence, CVSS, OWASP, AI enrichment.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.

success_criteria: Findings list renders from real GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/findings?theater=true.
Filter bar filters by severity and status.
Clicking finding opens drawer with Framer Motion slide-in.
Drawer shows raw_evidence in monospace code block with hash.
AI enrichment shown when available, 'Enrich Now' when not.
Mark as Fixed and False Positive buttons PATCH the finding.
Attack path tab shown only when compound_chain_id exists.
